example.romanization: Ngài vuk-hà yû yit chak kiéu.
example.english: There is a dog at my house.

note: Notice the sound shift: many Mandarin '-ou' finals correspond to Hakka '-eu'/'-ieu' (狗 gǒu → kiéu, 走 zǒu → chéu), a handy pattern for guessing new words. The measure word 隻 (chak) is used for animals, just like Mandarin 隻/只.
